Ashe.escape: Ashe has no ability to create distance on her own, so the moment Ashe W Volley is used is your chance to engage. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, watch out for its stun; close in with Rakan W Grand Entrance after the arrow is used. Keep an ally nearby to return to with Rakan E Battle Dance after engaging.
Ashe.combo: If you've used Rakan E Battle Dance first, use Rakan W Grand Entrance while E is still available to recast.
Ashe.fight: Trade after Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has worn off. To avoid being exposed to Ashe P Frost Shot for long, don't walk up to her; close the gap with Rakan W Grand Entrance. Before going in, check that an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Ashe.laning: Hit Ashe with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle where minions won't block it, and have Rakan P Fey Feathers' shield ready. Don't force the wave; catch Ashe with Rakan W Grand Entrance when she steps in front of the minion line.
Ashe.phase: In the late game, Rakan is easy to catch right after engaging, so watch for Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow and check your route back to an ally before going in.
Ashe.teamfight: If you need to catch Ashe, reach her with Rakan R The Quickness to charm her, then follow with Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock her up. If you need to protect your carries, hold Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up enemies who engage, and survive with Rakan E Battle Dance's shield and Rakan Q Gleaming Quill's healing. Decide which role you'll take before the team fight.
Ashe.watch: Ashe P Frost Shot's slow is refreshed with every auto attack, so don't stay within her auto attack range for long. Dodge Ashe W Volley by moving sideways, and create distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active. While Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is available, don't start a small fight from out of vision, and change your direction when dodging the arrow.

Pyke.phase: Mid game is Rakan’s peak, when his mobility lets him disrupt fights; in the late game, move with your allies so you aren’t caught immediately after engaging.
Pyke.build: Prioritize health so you can stay above Pyke R Death From Below’s execute threshold. Pyke deals physical damage, so if you build resistance, choose armor; don’t prioritize magic resistance.
Pyke.combo: When an ally is nearby, reposition toward them with Rakan E Battle Dance, then use Rakan W Grand Entrance for a knockup and follow with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and a basic attack. Return to an ally while the recast of Rakan E Battle Dance is still available.
Pyke.escape: Look for an opening after sidestepping the stun line from Pyke E Phantom Undertow. If only Pyke E Phantom Undertow is down, Pyke can still escape with Pyke R Death From Below, so target the window before Pyke R Death From Below comes back too. Then close the gap with Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan E Battle Dance, and catch him with Rakan R The Quickness.
Pyke.fight: Use Rakan W Grand Entrance to engage when an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby. After dodging Pyke E Phantom Undertow, look for an opening while Pyke R Death From Below is also unavailable.
Pyke.laning: Don’t force the wave; engage when the enemy ADC steps in front of the minions. Keep Pyke in vision as he backs off after a trade to prevent healing from Pyke P Gift of the Drowned Ones.
Pyke.teamfight: Decide first whether to engage or protect your carries. If you engage, charm enemies with Rakan R The Quickness and follow up with Rakan W Grand Entrance. If you protect, save Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up enemies who engage, and help your allies with Rakan E Battle Dance and Rakan Q Gleaming Quill. Don’t stand beside low-health allies, so you don’t get hit by Pyke R Death From Below together or trigger a chain of executes.
Pyke.watch: Watch out for the slow and pull from Pyke Q Bone Skewer, and sidestep out of the line left by Pyke E Phantom Undertow to avoid its stun. If you see the shark shadow from Pyke W Ghostwater Dive, retreat toward your allies or under your tower. When your health is low, stay wary of the range of Pyke R Death From Below.

Braum.watch: If Braum Q Winter's Bite or an auto attack applies a stack of Braum P Concussive Blows, get out of range before more stacks build. Braum E Unbreakable blocks projectiles from the front, so throw Rakan Q Gleaming Quill after his shield drops or from the side. Watch Braum's R Glacial Fissure cast animation and dodge sideways out of its line, and avoid the slow field it leaves behind.
Braum.build: Prioritize magic resistance based on Braum's main damage. The bigger threats from Braum are the stun from Braum P Concussive Blows and the knockup from Braum R Glacial Fissure, so still avoid the stacks and fissure even if you build resistance.
Braum.combo: After Braum W Stand Behind Me is down, close the gap by using Rakan E Battle Dance to an ally, knock Braum up with Rakan W Grand Entrance, then follow with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and an auto attack. Return to your ally while Rakan E Battle Dance is ready to recast.
Braum.escape: Immediately after Braum uses W Stand Behind Me is your window to close the gap with Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan E Battle Dance. If Braum R Glacial Fissure comes out, watch its cast animation and move out of its line before looking for an engage again. When going in with Rakan W Grand Entrance, check that an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Braum.fight: Have Rakan P Fey Feathers' shield ready, and look for an angle to hit an enemy champion with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill. Engage with Rakan W Grand Entrance after Braum W Stand Behind Me is down, when an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby. After trading, return to your ally with Rakan E Battle Dance to break Braum P Concussive Blows stacks.
Braum.laning: Throw Rakan Q Gleaming Quill at an enemy champion from an angle where the minion line is clear to chip away at their health and have Rakan P Fey Feathers' shield ready.
Braum.phase: Rakan peaks in the mid game, when his mobility lets him shake up the map. In the late game, move carefully to avoid getting caught right after engaging.
Braum.teamfight: If you need to protect your carries, hold Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up enemies who engage, and use Rakan E Battle Dance's shield and Rakan Q Gleaming Quill's healing. Decide your role ahead of time while avoiding the line and slow field from Braum R Glacial Fissure.

Alistar.build: Alistar Q Pulverize, W Headbutt, and E Trample all deal magic damage, so build magic resistance first. Armor does little to reduce this damage. If you are dying while locked down by crowd control, prioritize tenacity as well.
Alistar.fight: Poke Alistar with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle where minions won't block it, and have Rakan P Fey Feathers' shield ready. Engage with Rakan W Grand Entrance after Alistar W Headbutt and Q Pulverize are down, when an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Alistar.teamfight: If Alistar R Unbreakable Will is active, don't spend your damage on him; back off and wait out its duration. If you need to protect your carries, hold Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up enemies who engage, and survive with Rakan E Battle Dance's shield and Q Gleaming Quill's healing. If you can't back off, you can still apply new crowd control with Rakan W Grand Entrance or R The Quickness after Alistar activates R.
Alistar.combo: If Alistar W Headbutt and Q Pulverize are down, close the gap by using Rakan E Battle Dance to an ally, then knock Alistar up with Rakan W Grand Entrance. Follow with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and an auto attack, then return to your ally with Rakan E Battle Dance while its recast window remains.
Alistar.escape: Immediately after Alistar W Headbutt is down is your window to engage. If Alistar Q Pulverize is down too, you can close the gap with Rakan W Grand Entrance and E Battle Dance. Then use Rakan R The Quickness to apply a charm and continue the engage.
Alistar.laning: While Alistar Q Pulverize and W Headbutt are down, push the wave or reposition. Look for an opening to catch the enemy ADC with Rakan W Grand Entrance only when they step in front of the minion line.
Alistar.phase: In the late game, you can die easily if you are caught right after engaging, so check your Rakan E Battle Dance route back to an ally before going in.
Alistar.watch: After Alistar W Headbutt knocks you back, it is dangerous if Alistar Q Pulverize knocks you up or Alistar E Trample stuns you. This is especially true near a turret, so don't give Alistar room to circle behind you. Move forward only after both Alistar W Headbutt and Alistar Q Pulverize are down.

Janna.laning: Pressure the ally Janna is protecting to make her use Janna E Eye Of The Storm, then look for an opening after the shield wears off. Hit a champion with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle where minions won’t block it to poke and get the heal.
Janna.combo: For a short trade, use Rakan E Battle Dance to dash to an ally and close the distance, use W, then recast E to return.
Janna.escape: After Janna Q Howling Gale misses, look for a chance to go in with Rakan W Grand Entrance. If Janna R Monsoon is down, there is less risk of being knocked away. Before going in, check that an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Janna.fight: After forcing Janna to use E Eye Of The Storm, start a fight when Rakan P Fey Feathers is shielding you and an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby. Dodge Janna Q Howling Gale, then hit Rakan W Grand Entrance from a short distance out of vision or from a bush. If Rakan Q Gleaming Quill hits a champion, dash to an ally with E to trigger the heal right away.
Janna.phase: In the late game, Rakan can be caught easily right after engaging, so watch for Janna Q Howling Gale and Janna R Monsoon before going in.
Janna.teamfight: If you’re responsible for engaging, establish vision and catch Janna alone with Rakan R The Quickness and Rakan W Grand Entrance. If Janna R Monsoon is still available, she can knock you away, so watch for it. If you need to protect your carries, save W to knock up an enemy who dives in, then survive with the shield from Rakan E Battle Dance and the heal from Rakan Q Gleaming Quill.
Janna.watch: Janna Q Howling Gale can knock Rakan up and interrupt Rakan W Grand Entrance as he goes in, so avoid its path when you hear the tornado. Janna E Eye Of The Storm lets its target absorb damage and hit back harder, so attack after the shield is gone. Janna R Monsoon knocks away nearby enemies, so check whether it has been used before going in.

Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up after hitting something, so don’t stand clustered with allies or behind them. When Neeko is disguised with Neeko P Inherent Glamour, you can’t see the windup for Neeko R Pop Blossom, so spread out immediately if an opponent you suspect is Neeko approaches. Don’t chase Neeko W Shapesplitter’s clone; watch the original target.
Neeko.build: After buying one core item, fit in Quicksilver Sash so you can break free immediately after an engage if you are rooted by Neeko E Tangle-Barbs. Prioritize magic resistance against Neeko’s main damage. If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs into Neeko R Pop Blossom can kill you, prioritize tenacity over magic resistance.
Neeko.combo: If you plan to get out, check that the recast of Rakan E Battle Dance is still available and return to an ally.
Neeko.escape: The moment Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down is your chance to engage with Rakan W Grand Entrance. If there’s no ally you can reach with Rakan E Battle Dance, don’t use Rakan W Grand Entrance to start an engage recklessly.
Neeko.fight: The moment Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down, open a trade with Rakan W Grand Entrance when an ally you can reach with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby. Engage from a short distance from a bush or out of vision to give Neeko less time to dodge Rakan W Grand Entrance.
Neeko.laning: Harass Neeko with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle where minions won’t block it, while preparing the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers. Don’t force the wave; go in with an ally when Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down.
Neeko.phase: Use Rakan’s mobility to disrupt fights in the mid game, and be careful not to get caught by crowd control immediately after engaging in the late game.
Neeko.teamfight: Decide before the teamfight whether your role is to engage or protect your allies. If you’re engaging, watch for a disguised Neeko approaching, then apply a charm with Rakan R The Quickness and follow up with a knockup from Rakan W Grand Entrance. If you need to protect your allies, save Rakan W Grand Entrance and hold on with the shield from Rakan E Battle Dance and the healing from Rakan Q Gleaming Quill.

Maokai.build: After buying one core item, Rakan gets Quicksilver Sash to break the root applied right after he engages. Magic resistance is more effective than armor against Maokai’s damage. However, choose resistance based on the enemy damage dealer who attacks while Maokai has Rakan locked down, and consider tenacity against Maokai’s root.
Maokai.combo: After Maokai W Twisted Advance is down, hit Rakan W Grand Entrance from a short distance out of vision or from a bush, then follow with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and a basic attack. To get out, use Rakan E Battle Dance on an ally nearby.
Maokai.escape: Right after making Maokai use W Twisted Advance is your chance to go in. While Maokai R Nature’s Grasp is approaching, dodge it before engaging. Don’t rush to use Rakan W Grand Entrance if there’s no ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance.
Maokai.fight: If you keep hitting Maokai with abilities, Maokai P Sap Magic’s heal comes back sooner, so focus your poke on the enemy carry. Right after Maokai W Twisted Advance is down, close the distance with Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan E Battle Dance to trade. When using Rakan W Grand Entrance, make sure an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Maokai.laning: Hit the enemy carry with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle where minions won’t block it to chip away at their health and have Rakan P Fey Feathers’ shield ready. Don’t force a wave push; when the enemy carry steps in front of the minion line, go in if Maokai W Twisted Advance is down.
Maokai.phase: In the late game, getting caught by Maokai’s root right after engaging is dangerous, so plan your engage and escape routes first.
Maokai.teamfight: Before a team fight, decide whether to catch the enemy carry or protect your own. When engaging, charm enemies with Rakan R The Quickness in open terrain where you have room to dodge Maokai R Nature’s Grasp, then follow with Rakan W Grand Entrance. When protecting allies, save Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up an enemy who dives in, and use the shield from Rakan E Battle Dance and the heal from Rakan Q Gleaming Quill.
Maokai.watch: Watch out for the root from Maokai W Twisted Advance, and stay out of range near bushes while it’s available. Avoid bushes with Maokai E Sapling Toss, and if a sapling follows you, lead it toward minions or monsters rather than allies. If Maokai R Nature’s Grasp comes from a distance, move perpendicular to its direction of travel.

Seraphine.build: Rakan buys one core item first, then fits in Quicksilver Sash to break the root from Seraphine E Beat Drop if it catches him right after he engages. Seraphine’s damage is magic, so build magic resistance rather than armor.
Seraphine.combo: After dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop, close the distance from a brush or outside vision, use Rakan W Grand Entrance for a knockup, then follow with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and a basic attack. For a short trade, use Rakan E Battle Dance to dash to an ally and move forward, use Rakan W Grand Entrance for a knockup, then return with the recast of Rakan E Battle Dance.
Seraphine.escape: Seraphine has no mobility, so close the distance with Rakan W Grand Entrance just after avoiding Seraphine E Beat Drop. Engage when an ally is nearby so you can get out with Rakan E Battle Dance.
Seraphine.fight: The moment Seraphine E Beat Drop is down is your chance to engage. Before then, hit Seraphine with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle unobstructed by minions to chip away at her health and prepare Rakan P Fey Feathers' shield. Before going in with Rakan W Grand Entrance, make sure an ally is nearby to return to with Rakan E Battle Dance.
Seraphine.laning: Start a fight when Seraphine is alone and separated from an allied marksman, or when the enemy marksman steps in front of the minion line. Do not force the wave forward; poke with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and prepare Rakan P Fey Feathers' shield.
Seraphine.phase: Rakan peaks in the mid game, when his mobility lets him shape fights, so take advantage of the opening when Seraphine E Beat Drop is down. In the late game, getting crowd controlled right after engaging is dangerous, so check your escape route before going in.
Seraphine.teamfight: Before a teamfight, decide whether Rakan will engage first or protect an allied damage dealer. If protecting an ally, hold Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up an enemy who engages, and use Rakan E Battle Dance's shield and Rakan Q Gleaming Quill's heal. Spread out to the sides so Seraphine R Encore does not extend through your allies.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If you are hit by the slow, first move out of the straight line in front of Seraphine. In teamfights, Seraphine R Encore gains range each time it hits an ally, so do not line up.

Bard.build: Bard deals magic damage, so prioritize movement speed; if you build resistance, choose magic resistance. Rakan can move with Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan E Battle Dance, so first position yourself to dodge the stun from Bard Q Cosmic Binding.
Bard.combo: After Bard E Magical Journey is down, close the gap by using Rakan E Battle Dance to an ally, knock Bard up with Rakan W Grand Entrance, then follow with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and an auto attack. If Rakan E Battle Dance is ready to recast, return to an ally. After hitting a champion with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill, touch an ally to trigger the healing sooner.
Bard.escape: Immediately after you force Bard to use E Magical Journey is your chance to close in on him. If Bard Q Cosmic Binding is down too, the stun risk is lower, so go in with Rakan W Grand Entrance and check that an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Bard.fight: When the minion line is clear, hit Bard with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill to chip away at his health and have Rakan P Fey Feathers' shield ready. Engage with Rakan W Grand Entrance after Bard E Magical Journey is down, when an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Bard.laning: If you see Bard W Caretaker's Shrine, walk over it to remove it.
Bard.phase: In the mid game, use your mobility to keep up with Bard's movement and create roaming opportunities. In the late game, Rakan is easy to catch right after engaging, so check for ally support and a route back before going in.
Bard.teamfight: If you need to catch the enemy carries, charm multiple enemies with Rakan R The Quickness and knock them up with Rakan W Grand Entrance. If you need to protect your carries, hold Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up enemies who engage, and survive with Rakan E Battle Dance's shield and Rakan Q Gleaming Quill's healing.
Bard.watch: Bard Q Cosmic Binding stuns if it hits a wall or a second target, so don't stand with your back to a wall or in a line with an ally or minion. Bard can come in from the side with E Magical Journey, so watch your flanks. When engaging, account for the fact that damage is ineffective within Bard R Tempered Fate's area.

Blitzcrank.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for the damage from Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab and R Static Field. Magic resistance can't block the physical damage from Blitzcrank E Power Fist. Blitzcrank R Static Field destroys shields, so avoid choices that rely on shields alone.
Blitzcrank.combo: If Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab is down and an ally is nearby, close the gap by using Rakan E Battle Dance to that ally, knock Blitzcrank up with Rakan W Grand Entrance, then follow with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and an auto attack. Return to your ally while Rakan E Battle Dance is ready to recast.
Blitzcrank.escape: The moment Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses is your chance to engage. Blitzcrank has no ability to create distance on his own, so if you catch him with Rakan W Grand Entrance and follow with Rakan R The Quickness, it will be difficult for him to escape. Before going in, check that an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Blitzcrank.fight: Immediately after Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses, poke or trade with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill. Use Rakan W Grand Entrance when an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby. If you get an opening to catch Blitzcrank, charm him with Rakan R The Quickness and knock him up with Rakan W Grand Entrance.
Blitzcrank.laning: Always keep minions between you and Blitzcrank, and walk far from bushes if you don't have vision in them. Push the lane or trade when Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab misses or he lacks mana. Hit champions with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle where minions won't block it to aim for both poke and healing.
Blitzcrank.phase: In the mid game, use your mobility to shake up the map and look for roams. In the late game, getting caught right after engaging is dangerous, so choose your engages carefully.
Blitzcrank.teamfight: If your team needs to catch the enemy carries, don't stay on Blitzcrank; go around to the back line, charm them with Rakan R The Quickness, then knock them up with Rakan W Grand Entrance. If you need to protect your carries, hold Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up enemies who engage and help your allies with Rakan E Battle Dance and Rakan Q Gleaming Quill. Watch your engage route, since Blitzcrank R Static Field can destroy shields and silence you.
Blitzcrank.watch: Blitzcrank Q Rocket Grab pulls the first target it hits, so dodge it by standing behind minions. After the pull, Blitzcrank can follow up with the knockup from E Power Fist and the silence from R Static Field, so don't engage first with Rakan W Grand Entrance while the hook is available. Blitzcrank R Static Field also destroys shields, so don't rely on just Rakan P Fey Feathers or Rakan E Battle Dance's shield to survive.

Brand.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Brand's damage. Brand P Blaze deals damage that scales with maximum health, so prioritize magic resistance and movement speed to get out of marked areas over simply stacking health.
Brand.combo: When Brand's poke abilities are down, close the gap by using Rakan E Battle Dance to an ally, knock Brand up with Rakan W Grand Entrance, then follow with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and an auto attack. Return to your ally while Rakan E Battle Dance is ready to recast.
Brand.escape: Brand has no mobility abilities, so immediately after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down is your chance to engage. If you aren't ablaze, Brand Q Sear won't stun you, but if you are ablaze, dodge Brand Q Sear before going in.
Brand.fight: Engage with Rakan W Grand Entrance after Brand W Pillar of Flame is down, when an ally close enough to target with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Brand.laning: Stand clear of ablaze minions, and look for Brand if he remains in range after using Brand W Pillar of Flame.
Brand.phase: In the mid game, use your mobility to create opportunities. In the late game, be careful not to get caught right after engaging.
Brand.teamfight: Before engaging, keep your distance from allies to reduce the spread of Brand E Conflagration and the bounces from Brand R Pyroclasm, and don't stand beside an ally who is ablaze. If you're the engager, charm enemies with Rakan R The Quickness, then knock them up with Rakan W Grand Entrance. If you're protecting allies, hold Rakan W Grand Entrance and use Rakan E Battle Dance's shield and Rakan Q Gleaming Quill's healing.
Brand.watch: If Brand W Pillar of Flame and Brand Q Sear hit you in succession, Brand P Blaze can stack and explode, so dodge the first ability. While ablaze, Brand Q Sear stuns you, so leave the projectile's path or hide behind minions. Also watch out for Brand E Conflagration spreading beside an ablaze minion.

Heimerdinger.build: All of Heimerdinger's damaging abilities deal magic damage, so build magic resistance before armor. Also get movement speed to escape the range of his turrets and grenade.
Heimerdinger.combo: Close the gap from a bush or out of vision, knock Heimerdinger up with Rakan W Grand Entrance, then follow with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and an auto attack. If an ally is in front, engage by using Rakan E Battle Dance to them; use Rakan W Grand Entrance while E is available to recast, then return to your ally.
Heimerdinger.escape: Heimerdinger has no ability to create distance on his own, so close the gap from the side and check that an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby before engaging.
Heimerdinger.fight: Don't repeatedly trade damage in front of the turrets; approach Heimerdinger himself from the side or from a bush.
Heimerdinger.laning: Hit Heimerdinger with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle where minions won't block it to chip away at his health and have Rakan P Fey Feathers' shield ready.
Heimerdinger.phase: In the mid game, when Rakan's mobility shines, change your angle to start fights. In the late game, Rakan is easy to catch right after engaging, so choose your engages carefully.
Heimerdinger.teamfight: If you need to catch the enemy carries, go around Heimerdinger's turret setup, charm them with Rakan R The Quickness, then follow with Rakan W Grand Entrance. If you need to protect your carries, hold Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up enemies who engage, and use Rakan E Battle Dance's shield and Rakan Q Gleaming Quill's healing. When Heimerdinger R UPGRADE!!! is available, don't group in a narrow passage or in one spot in front of an objective.
Heimerdinger.watch: When you see the landing indicator, move sideways to avoid the center; if you get hit, move out of turret range.

Hwei.build: After buying your first core item, fit Quicksilver Sash into your build to deal with your engage being interrupted while immobilized by Hwei E Subject: Torment. Build magic resistance against Hwei's damage, and get movement speed to escape marked areas. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that add a lot of health alone.
Hwei.combo: If you engaged by first using Rakan E Battle Dance to an ally, return with Rakan E Battle Dance again after Rakan W Grand Entrance.
Hwei.escape: Immediately after Hwei E Subject: Torment is down is your window to engage. Hwei has no mobility abilities, so close the gap with Rakan W Grand Entrance, and if an ally is nearby, secure a way back with Rakan E Battle Dance. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, wait so you don't get rooted or forced to move at the front of the engage.
Hwei.fight: Engage with Rakan W Grand Entrance just after Hwei E Subject: Torment is used for poke or wave clear, when an ally you can reach with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Hwei.laning: Hit an enemy champion with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill to chip away at their health and have Rakan P Fey Feathers' shield ready. Hwei's eye can root you, so check your engage route; if there is an eye, go around it or use minions to trigger it.
Hwei.phase: Rakan peaks in the mid game, when his mobility lets him shake up the map, so actively take opportunities when Hwei E Subject: Torment is down. In the late game, Rakan can die easily if caught right after engaging, so check for an ally and a route back before going in.
Hwei.teamfight: If the team fight calls for you to protect your carries, hold Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up enemies who engage, and survive with Rakan E Battle Dance's shield and Rakan Q Gleaming Quill's healing. Avoid engaging through corridors where Hwei has placed a zone.
Hwei.watch: If you are caught by Hwei E Subject: Torment's snare or forced movement, you are likely to get hit by the follow-up attacks too. If the first ability hits you, move immediately to avoid the second ability and the Hwei P Signature of the Visionary explosion. Also watch out for the slow from Hwei R Spiraling Despair.

Karma.build: Karma’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Rakan can be interrupted by Karma W Focused Resolve’s root right after engaging, so fit Quicksilver Sash into your build after one core item.
Karma.combo: For a basic engage, knock them up with Rakan W Grand Entrance from out of vision, then follow with Q Gleaming Quill and a basic attack. To use an ally as a launch point, dash to them with Rakan E Battle Dance, knock the target up with W Grand Entrance, then recast E Battle Dance to return.
Karma.escape: After Karma W Focused Resolve is down, look for a chance to go in with Rakan W Grand Entrance. Wait for the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire to end before engaging. If Karma W Focused Resolve links to you after you go in, use Rakan E Battle Dance to return to an ally and create distance.
Karma.fight: Hit Karma with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle where there’s a gap in the minion line to chip away at her health, and have Rakan P Fey Feathers’ shield ready. Use Rakan W Grand Entrance from a short distance out of vision, and start a fight when an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Karma.laning: Move behind minions or out of range so you don’t let Karma poke you for free and charge Karma R Mantra. Don’t force a wave push; look for an angle to use Rakan W Grand Entrance when the enemy marksman steps in front of the minion line.
Karma.phase: In the late game, getting caught right after engaging is dangerous, so check whether Karma W Focused Resolve is available.
Karma.teamfight: If you’re responsible for engaging, draw out Karma W Focused Resolve first and wait for the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire to end. Then charm with Rakan R The Quickness and knock them up with W Grand Entrance. If you need to protect your carries, save Rakan W Grand Entrance and survive with the shield from E Battle Dance and the heal from Q Gleaming Quill.
Karma.watch: Reposition to avoid Karma Q Inner Flame, which slows and deals area damage, and immediately walk out of the area left by Karma R Mantra-empowered Q Inner Flame. If Karma W Focused Resolve links to you, create distance to break the tether before it roots you. Delay your engage right after Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire shields nearby allies.

Leona.build: After buying one core item, fit Quicksilver Sash into your build to prepare for being rooted by Leona E Zenith Blade right after engaging. Magic resistance helps against Leona’s own damage, but choose your final resistance based on the damage type of the enemy carry who attacks while Leona has you locked down.
Leona.combo: After Leona E Zenith Blade is down, dash to an ally with Rakan E Battle Dance to close the distance, knock them up with Rakan W Grand Entrance, then use Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and a basic attack. Make sure Rakan E Battle Dance is available to recast, then return to your ally. If Rakan Q Gleaming Quill hits a champion, the heal triggers as soon as you reach your ally.
Leona.escape: Leona E Zenith Blade is her only mobility ability, so right after making her use it is your window to close the distance with Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan E Battle Dance. Stay outside the range where Leona Q Shield of Daybreak can stun you; when going in, check the ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance and its recast window.
Leona.fight: Hit a champion with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle where minions won’t block it to chip away at their health and have Rakan P Fey Feathers’ shield ready. Right after Leona E Zenith Blade is down, go in with Rakan W Grand Entrance when an ally you can dash to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby. If Leona W Eclipse is active, get out of range before it explodes.
Leona.laning: Don’t stand in line with your allied marksman, to avoid giving Leona E Zenith Blade an angle to reach a farther target. Don’t force a wave push; look for an angle to use Rakan W Grand Entrance when the enemy marksman steps in front of the minion line.
Leona.phase: Use Rakan’s mobility to turn fights in the mid game. In the late game, choose your engages carefully because getting caught by crowd control right after engaging can get you killed.
Leona.teamfight: If you need to protect your carries, save Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up an enemy who dives in, then survive with the shield from Rakan E Battle Dance and the heal from Rakan Q Gleaming Quill. If you need to catch an enemy carry, charm multiple enemies with Rakan R The Quickness and follow with Rakan W Grand Entrance. If Leona P Sunlight marks you, that signals a follow-up attack is coming, so back off immediately.
Leona.watch: Leona E Zenith Blade pierces in a straight line and pulls her to the last champion hit, so don’t stand in line with your allied marksman. Leona Q Shield of Daybreak can be activated before she approaches, so watch the distance at which she can reach you rather than whether she has used the ability. When Leona W Eclipse is active, get out of range before it explodes. When Leona R Solar Flare’s indicator appears, move sideways to avoid the stun at its center.

Lulu.build: The information available isn’t enough to determine your first purchase. If Lulu’s damage is a problem, consider magic resistance, but choose your resistance based on the damage type of the target Lulu is protecting. Also consider tenacity against the crowd control from Lulu W Whimsy and Lulu R Wild Growth.
Lulu.combo: If Lulu W Whimsy is down, dash to an ally with Rakan E Battle Dance to close the distance, knock them up with Rakan W Grand Entrance, then follow with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and a basic attack. For a short trade, make sure Rakan E Battle Dance is available to recast, then return to your ally.
Lulu.escape: After Lulu W Whimsy is used on another ally, look for a chance to go in with Rakan W Grand Entrance. If Lulu R Wild Growth is also down, there’s less need to worry about the knockup and health increase. Before engaging, check that an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Lulu.fight: Poke with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle where there’s a gap in the minion line, and have Rakan P Fey Feathers’ shield ready. Go in with Rakan W Grand Entrance after Lulu W Whimsy has been used on another ally and an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Lulu.laning: Rather than forcing a wave push, keep poking with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and look for an engage when the enemy steps in front of the minion line. Look for a mid-lane roam right after pushing the wave under the enemy turret.
Lulu.phase: Move actively in the mid game, when your mobility can turn fights, and engage carefully in the late game so you aren’t caught right after going in.
Lulu.teamfight: If you need to protect your carries, save Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up an enemy who dives in, then survive with the shield from Rakan E Battle Dance and the heal from Rakan Q Gleaming Quill. If you need to engage, charm multiple enemies with Rakan R The Quickness, then follow with Rakan W Grand Entrance. If Lulu R Wild Growth is available, don’t count on getting a kill on the target she’s protecting; look for Lulu or another target instead.
Lulu.watch: If you go in with Rakan W Grand Entrance while Lulu W Whimsy is available, it can stop you with a silence, so wait until you see her use it on another ally. Lulu R Wild Growth increases its target’s health and knocks up nearby enemies, so don’t spend all your abilities on a target while R is available.

Lux.build: After buying one core item, get Quicksilver Sash to prepare for being rooted by Lux Q Light Binding right after engaging. Magic resistance is more useful than armor against Lux’s main damage. Also get movement speed so you can leave the area covered by Lux E Lucent Singularity.
Lux.combo: To use an ally as a launch point, dash forward with Rakan E Battle Dance, knock them up with Rakan W Grand Entrance, then return with Rakan E Battle Dance while the recast is available.
Lux.escape: Right after baiting out Lux Q Light Binding and dodging it is your chance to engage. Lux has no mobility ability to create distance on her own, so close in with Rakan W Grand Entrance and make sure you have an ally to return to with Rakan E Battle Dance.
Lux.fight: Poke Lux with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle where there’s a gap in the minion line, and keep Rakan P Fey Feathers’ shield ready. Go in with Rakan W Grand Entrance when Lux Q Light Binding misses and an ally you can use Rakan E Battle Dance on is nearby.
Lux.laning: Spread out sideways from your allies so Lux Q Light Binding can’t hit you together. Don’t force a wave push; look for an opening when Lux steps in front of the minion line or you get a short engage angle from a bush or the side.
Lux.phase: In the late game, getting caught once right after engaging can get you killed, so make sure Lux Q Light Binding is down before going in.
Lux.teamfight: If you’re responsible for engaging, spread out and approach from different directions so Lux E Lucent Singularity can’t stop you all at once. After Lux Q Light Binding misses, charm multiple enemies with Rakan R The Quickness and follow with Rakan W Grand Entrance. If you need to protect your carries, save Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up an enemy who dives in, then survive with the shield from Rakan E Battle Dance and the heal from Rakan Q Gleaming Quill.
Lux.watch: If Lux Q Light Binding hits you, you’re likely to get hit by follow-up abilities, so bait it out and go in after it misses. Lux Q Light Binding roots up to the first two targets it hits, so don’t stand in line with an ally. When the red targeting line for Lux R Final Spark appears, move sideways. If one of Lux’s abilities hits you, keep your distance so she can’t trigger her Illumination mark with a basic attack.

Milio.build: If fights drag on against Milio W Cozy Campfire and Milio R Breath of Life, get Grievous Wounds. Milio deals magic damage, but not much, so choose your resistance based on the enemy carry’s damage type.
Milio.combo: From out of vision, go in a short distance with Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock them up, then use Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and a basic attack.
Milio.escape: When Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down, you have a chance to engage. Check that an ally you can use Rakan E Battle Dance on is nearby, then go in with Rakan W Grand Entrance. Also check the recast window for Rakan E Battle Dance, which you will use to escape.
Milio.fight: Hit Milio with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle where minions don’t block it to chip away at his health and have Rakan P Fey Feathers’ shield ready. Use Rakan W Grand Entrance when there’s an ally you can escape to with Rakan E Battle Dance.
Milio.laning: Don’t force a wave push; engage when Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick is down or the enemy marksman steps in front of the minions. Look for a mid-lane roam right after pushing the wave under the enemy turret.
Milio.phase: Milio’s team gets stronger as the game goes on, so look for trades and wave control early, and be careful not to get caught right after engaging as Rakan in the late game.
Milio.teamfight: When engaging, target Milio himself, who has no mobility ability, first to look for a chance to cut off the enemy’s healing. Milio R Breath of Life can remove charm but not knockups, so use Rakan R The Quickness followed by Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock enemies up. If your team needs you to protect its carries, save Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up an enemy who dives in, then survive with the shield from Rakan E Battle Dance and the heal from Rakan Q Gleaming Quill.
Milio.watch: Milio Q Ultra Mega Fire Kick knocks back the first enemy it hits, so check whether it has been used before engaging with Rakan W Grand Entrance. Delay the fight while Milio W Cozy Campfire is active and the enemy marksman’s attack range is increased.

Morgana.build: Build magic resistance first against Morgana Q Dark Binding and Morgana W Tormented Shadow. To prepare for being rooted right after engaging, fit Quicksilver Sash into your build after one core item. If Morgana P Soul Siphon and the healing from Morgana W Tormented Shadow are a problem in long fights, consider Grievous Wounds.
Morgana.combo: If there’s an ally to return to, escape with the recast of Rakan E Battle Dance. If Rakan Q Gleaming Quill hits, the heal triggers as soon as you reach your ally.
Morgana.escape: When Morgana Q Dark Binding is down and Morgana E Black Shield is absent, you have a chance to engage. Morgana has no ability to create distance on her own, so close in with Rakan W Grand Entrance, but check the ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance and its recast window. If Morgana R Soul Shackles links to you, get out with Rakan W Grand Entrance or Rakan E Battle Dance before the stun goes off.
Morgana.fight: Poke with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and have Rakan P Fey Feathers’ shield ready. Start a fight when there’s an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance. Don’t use crowd control on a target protected by Morgana E Black Shield; close the distance after the shield is down.
Morgana.laning: Stay in line with minions to block Morgana Q Dark Binding, but throw Rakan Q Gleaming Quill at a champion from an angle where minions won’t block it. Don’t force a wave push; look for an angle to use Rakan W Grand Entrance when the enemy marksman steps in front of the minions.
Morgana.phase: Rakan peaks in the mid game, when his mobility can turn fights, so take advantage of opportunities when Morgana Q Dark Binding and Morgana E Black Shield are down. In the late game, getting caught right after engaging can get you killed, so check your escape route before going in.
Morgana.teamfight: If you need to protect your carries, save Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up an enemy who dives in, then survive with the shield from Rakan E Battle Dance and the heal from Rakan Q Gleaming Quill.
Morgana.watch: Move with minions between you and Morgana Q Dark Binding, which catches the first target it hits. When your health is low, don’t walk over Morgana W Tormented Shadow. If Morgana R Soul Shackles links to you, get out of range with Rakan W Grand Entrance or Rakan E Battle Dance before the stun.

Nami.build: Consider Morellonomicon first to reduce the healing from Nami W Ebb and Flow. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Nami’s ability damage. Movement speed also helps you dodge the telegraphed Nami Q Aqua Prison and Nami R Tidal Wave.
Nami.combo: When using an ally as a launch point, dash forward to them with Rakan E Battle Dance, knock enemies up with Rakan W Grand Entrance, then return with Rakan E Battle Dance while its recast is available.
Nami.escape: Right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses is a good window to engage with Rakan W Grand Entrance. Sidestep Nami R Tidal Wave, then dodge the Nami Q Aqua Prison that will follow before engaging. Nami has no mobility ability, so once you close the gap, catch her with Rakan R The Quickness.
Nami.fight: Hit Nami with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle where minions won’t block it, lowering her health while preparing the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers. Target Nami with Rakan W Grand Entrance when Nami Q Aqua Prison misses and an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Nami.laning: Take an angle toward Nami from a bush or out of vision to shorten the distance for Rakan W Grand Entrance. Don’t force a wave push; treat the moment right after Nami Q Aqua Prison misses as your chance to attack.
Nami.phase: In the late game, Rakan is in danger if he gets caught immediately after engaging, so check your allies’ positions before going in.
Nami.teamfight: If you need to catch an enemy carry, take a path that lets Rakan R The Quickness reach multiple enemies, then follow up with Rakan W Grand Entrance. If you need to protect your carries, save Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up enemies who engage, and hold on with the shield from Rakan E Battle Dance and the healing from Rakan Q Gleaming Quill. If you see Nami R Tidal Wave, sidestep and watch for the Nami Q Aqua Prison that follows.
Nami.watch: Nami Q Aqua Prison falls slowly, but stuns you if it hits, so sidestep when you see it coming. Sidestep Nami R Tidal Wave as soon as you see it, and save Rakan W Grand Entrance to prepare for the Nami Q Aqua Prison that will follow. If Nami E Tidecaller's Blessing is on an enemy, don’t trade into its slow and empowered attacks; fight after it expires.

Nautilus.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for the damage from Nautilus Q Dredge Line, W Titan's Wrath, and E Riptide. After your first core item, consider Quicksilver Sash so you can break Nautilus P Staggering Blow’s root immediately after your engage.
Nautilus.escape: Engage as soon as Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down. Don’t linger in his basic attack range, so Nautilus P Staggering Blow doesn’t root you, and use Rakan W Grand Entrance while the recast of Rakan E Battle Dance is available to return to an ally.
Nautilus.fight: Right after Nautilus Q Dredge Line misses is your chance to trade and engage. When an ally can be targeted by Rakan E Battle Dance, knock the enemy up with Rakan W Grand Entrance, then return with the recast of Rakan E Battle Dance.
Nautilus.laning: Keep minions between you and Nautilus to block Nautilus Q Dredge Line, but find an angle where the minion line is clear when you throw Rakan Q Gleaming Quill. Engage with Rakan W Grand Entrance when an ally is in range of Rakan E Battle Dance and the enemy ADC steps in front of the minions.
Nautilus.phase: Use the opening when Nautilus Q Dredge Line is down during Rakan’s mobile mid game, and engage cautiously in the late game, when you are easy to catch.
Nautilus.teamfight: If you need to catch an enemy carry, charm multiple enemies with Rakan R The Quickness and follow up with Rakan W Grand Entrance. If you need to protect your carries, save Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up enemies who engage, and hold on with the shield from Rakan E Battle Dance and the healing from Rakan Q Gleaming Quill. When Nautilus R Depth Charge is available, don’t overlap with your allies along your engage path.
Nautilus.watch: Nautilus Q Dredge Line is his main engage, so dodge it with minions between you. If you are rooted by the first attack from Nautilus P Staggering Blow, his follow-up abilities are likely to hit, so stay out of his attack range. Nautilus R Depth Charge follows its target and knocks up allies along its path, so don’t stand too close to each other.

Pantheon.build: Buy armor first to prepare for Pantheon’s main damage, including Pantheon Q Comet Spear and Pantheon W Shield Vault. Pantheon W Shield Vault deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a lot of health.
Pantheon.combo: Hit Rakan W Grand Entrance from close range out of vision or from a bush, then follow with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and a basic attack. When getting out, return to an ally with the available recast of Rakan E Battle Dance.
Pantheon.escape: The opening to engage is after Pantheon W Shield Vault is down and before Pantheon R Grand Starfall is available again. Close the gap with Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan E Battle Dance, then prevent him from escaping by charming him with Rakan R The Quickness.
Pantheon.fight: Harass with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill to prepare the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers, then fight. When Pantheon uses Pantheon E Aegis Assault, hold off on attacking him from the front until it ends, or move around to his side. Before going in with Rakan W Grand Entrance, check that an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Pantheon.laning: Keep minions between you and Pantheon against Pantheon Q Comet Spear, but hit champions with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle where the minion line is clear. Even if you have both Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan E Battle Dance, only commit all-in when an ally is nearby.
Pantheon.phase: Pantheon’s influence falls off in the late game, but Rakan is also easy to catch immediately after engaging, so choose your engages carefully.
Pantheon.teamfight: If you need to protect your carries, save Rakan W Grand Entrance for Pantheon’s engage, knock up the enemy who goes in, then hold on with the shield from Rakan E Battle Dance and the healing from Rakan Q Gleaming Quill. If you need to catch an enemy carry, charm them with Rakan R The Quickness and follow up with Rakan W Grand Entrance.
Pantheon.watch: Pantheon W Shield Vault targets and stuns, so don’t give him range to use it. Keep minions between you and Pantheon when he harasses with Pantheon Q Comet Spear, and walk out of the landing area when you see the warning for Pantheon R Grand Starfall.

Rell.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Rell P Break the Mold, Rell Q Shattering Strike, and Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down. Rell E Full Tilt deals damage based on maximum health, so avoid choices that only add a lot of health.
Rell.combo: After Rell E Full Tilt is down, close the gap by using Rakan E Battle Dance to reach an ally, then use Rakan W Grand Entrance for a knockup and follow with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and a basic attack. If the recast of Rakan E Battle Dance is still available, return to an ally.
Rell.escape: Don’t go in just because Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down is down; check whether Rell E Full Tilt is down too. The window before Rell E Full Tilt comes back is especially good for closing the gap with Rakan W Grand Entrance and Rakan E Battle Dance and following up with Rakan R The Quickness.
Rell.fight: Lower health with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from outside Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down range while preparing the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers. After Rell E Full Tilt has been used and before it becomes available again, engage with Rakan W Grand Entrance when an ally you can reach with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Rell.laning: Harass Rell with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle where minions won’t block it, and stop trading and back off when Rell E Full Tilt is active.
Rell.phase: Rakan is easy to catch immediately after engaging in the late game, so choose your engages carefully.
Rell.teamfight: Spread out from your allies before a teamfight so Rell R Magnet Storm doesn’t pull several of you in together. If you need to protect your carries, save Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up Rell as she engages, then use the shield from Rakan E Battle Dance and the healing from Rakan Q Gleaming Quill after Rell Q Shattering Strike is down. If you need to catch an enemy carry, charm them with Rakan R The Quickness and follow up with Rakan W Grand Entrance.
Rell.watch: When Rell E Full Tilt speeds up Rell and one ally, Rell W Ferromancy: Crash Down may follow soon, so move out of range. Rell Q Shattering Strike breaks shields, so sidestep it and use the shield from Rakan E Battle Dance after Rell Q Shattering Strike is down.

Renata.build: After buying one core item, get Quicksilver Sash to respond to being rooted by Renata Glasc Q Handshake or hit by Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover immediately after engaging. Against Renata Glasc’s damage, choose magic resistance over armor if you build resistance. Renata Glasc P Leverage deals damage based on maximum health, so be careful about choices that only add a lot of health.
Renata.combo: For a standard engage, close the gap by reaching an ally with Rakan E Battle Dance, knock the target up with Rakan W Grand Entrance, then follow with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and a basic attack. If the recast of Rakan E Battle Dance is still available, use it to return to an ally.
Renata.escape: Renata Glasc has no mobility ability, so the window after Renata Glasc Q Handshake is down is your chance to close the gap. Go in with Rakan W Grand Entrance, but if Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, don’t engage with your allies lined up together. Use Rakan W Grand Entrance cautiously when there’s no ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance.
Renata.fight: Hit Renata Glasc with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle where the minion line is clear, lowering her health while preparing the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers. Cast Rakan W Grand Entrance from close range after approaching from a bush or out of vision, giving Renata Glasc less time to step aside. Before going in, check that an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Renata.laning: Don’t force the wave; look for an angle for Rakan W Grand Entrance when Renata Glasc or the enemy ADC steps in front of the minion line. Throw Rakan Q Gleaming Quill so minions aren’t hit first, harassing Renata Glasc and getting healing.
Renata.phase: Create opportunities with your mobility in the mid game, and be especially careful not to get caught by crowd control immediately after engaging in the late game.
Renata.teamfight: If you need to catch an enemy carry, charm them with Rakan R The Quickness and follow up with Rakan W Grand Entrance, but keep your distance from allies while Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available. If you need to protect your carries, save Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up enemies who engage, and hold on with the shield from Rakan E Battle Dance and the healing from Rakan Q Gleaming Quill. If you kill an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout, retreat so that remaining nearby does not allow your allies to die.
Renata.watch: If you are hit by Renata Glasc Q Handshake, you are rooted, and you can stun allies when thrown, so be especially careful when engaging. While Renata Glasc R Hostile Takeover is available, keep your distance from allies; if you are hit, use a crowd control cleanse immediately. Right after killing an enemy affected by Renata Glasc W Bailout, retreat with your allies to prevent that enemy from contributing to a kill.

Senna.build: Build armor first against Senna’s main damage, and get health alongside armor. Consider Quicksilver Sash after one core item, since Senna W Last Embrace can root you and interrupt your engage.
Senna.combo: When you need to get out, engage by dashing to an ally with Rakan E Battle Dance, then return to an ally while its recast is still available.
Senna.escape: When Senna W Last Embrace is down, you have a chance to close the gap without being rooted. Senna has no ability to create distance on her own, so get on her with Rakan W Grand Entrance and, if an ally is nearby, keep a way back with Rakan E Battle Dance. When you see the mist approaching as Senna E Curse of the Black Mist activates, don’t hold your ground there; retreat to a place with vision.
Senna.fight: Before engaging Senna, check that an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Senna.laning: Watch where Senna is likely to step forward to collect a soul, then wait for the opportunity to harass her. When Senna steps in front of the minion line, look for an angle to catch her with Rakan W Grand Entrance; it’s easier to hit from close range out of a bush or out of vision. Dodge the line attack from Senna Q Piercing Darkness while hitting her with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill to prepare the shield from Rakan P Fey Feathers.
Senna.phase: Senna’s attack range and attack damage grow in the late game, while Rakan is easy to catch immediately after engaging, so choose your engages carefully.
Senna.teamfight: When you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, camouflaged enemies may approach, so retreat to a place with vision. If you need to catch an enemy carry, charm them with Rakan R The Quickness, then knock them up with Rakan W Grand Entrance. If you need to protect your carries, save Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up enemies who engage, and hold on with the shield from Rakan E Battle Dance and the healing from Rakan Q Gleaming Quill.
Senna.watch: Dodge Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions; it takes time to root you after it hits, and if you are marked, immediately move away from your allies. Senna Q Piercing Darkness travels in a straight line through its target, so avoid the line connecting Senna to a minion or one of her allies. If Senna hits you once, back off so you don’t give her Mist through a second attack.

Sona.build: Sona's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Have at least one anti-heal item on your team for her late-game healing; if a magic damage dealer is buying it, choose Morellonomicon.
Sona.combo: For a standard engage, knock her up with Rakan W Grand Entrance, then follow with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and basic attacks. If an ally is ahead, use Rakan E Battle Dance to dash to them, land Rakan W Grand Entrance, then return with Rakan E Battle Dance while it is available again.
Sona.escape: Decide to engage before Sona E Song of Celerity is activated. Against Sona with increased movement speed, apply crowd control first with Rakan W Grand Entrance or Rakan R The Quickness. If Sona R Crescendo is down, engage during the opening when the risk of being stunned is lower. After using Rakan W Grand Entrance, check that an ally is nearby to return to with Rakan E Battle Dance.
Sona.fight: When Sona steps forward to share her aura, hit her with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle unobstructed by minions to chip away at her health and prepare Rakan P Fey Feathers' shield. Shorten the distance from outside vision before landing Rakan W Grand Entrance, and engage when an ally is available to return to with Rakan E Battle Dance.
Sona.laning: Make Sona spend mana on healing without forcing the wave forward, and look for the moment she steps up.
Sona.phase: In the late game, Sona scales well and her team's healing becomes strong, while Rakan is also easy to catch right after engaging, so avoid forcing an engage.
Sona.teamfight: When initiating, use Rakan R The Quickness to disrupt Sona's position among the allied group, then follow with Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock her up. If you need to protect an allied damage dealer, hold Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up an enemy who engages, and add Rakan E Battle Dance's shield and Rakan Q Gleaming Quill's heal. Do not stand in a line in front of Sona, so multiple allies do not get hit by Sona R Crescendo.
Sona.watch: Sona R Crescendo stuns multiple enemies in a line, so spread out to the sides with your allies when Sona steps forward. After Sona has used several basic abilities and comes within basic attack range, watch for Sona P Power Chord's empowered attack and create distance in advance.

Soraka.build: Build magic resistance rather than armor against Soraka's damage. If Soraka E Equinox's root interrupts your engage, fit Quicksilver Sash in after one core item. If Soraka's healing becomes a problem in a long fight, consider anti-heal after magic resistance.
Soraka.combo: If you need to get out, check whether Rakan E Battle Dance's recast on an ally is still available.
Soraka.escape: The moment Soraka E Equinox is down is your chance to engage. Soraka has no mobility, so close the distance with Rakan W Grand Entrance, but go in only when an ally is there for you to return to with Rakan E Battle Dance.
Soraka.fight: Engage when Soraka E Equinox is down and an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Soraka.laning: Poke with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle unobstructed by minions to prepare Rakan P Fey Feathers' shield. Pressure the enemy alongside your allied marksman to force Soraka W Astral Infusion, but dodge Soraka Q Starcall.
Soraka.phase: In the late game, getting caught by crowd control right after engaging is dangerous, so choose your engage angle carefully.
Soraka.teamfight: Engage so your allies can kill Soraka herself instead of continuing to hit the target she is healing. If you are initiating, charm her with Rakan R The Quickness, then knock her up with Rakan W Grand Entrance. If you need to protect an allied damage dealer, hold Rakan W Grand Entrance and endure with Rakan E Battle Dance's shield and Rakan Q Gleaming Quill's heal.
Soraka.watch: Soraka E Equinox silences you and can also root you, so use your engage ability before stepping into its zone. If Soraka Q Starcall hits, Soraka heals and gains movement speed, so pressure her while dodging it.

Swain.build: After completing your first core item, fit in Quicksilver Sash in case Swain E Nevermove catches and roots you right after you engage. Swain's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance; if you need to fight for a long time, prepare anti-heal after getting resistance.
Swain.combo: If an ally is available for your exit, dash to them first with Rakan E Battle Dance, use Rakan W Grand Entrance, then return with the available recast of Rakan E Battle Dance.
Swain.escape: Swain has no escape ability, so the moment after you dodge even the returning wave of Swain E Nevermove is your chance to engage. Check that Rakan E Battle Dance is available to target an ally, then close the distance with Rakan W Grand Entrance.
Swain.fight: Trade with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and keep Rakan P Fey Feathers' shield charged. Engage with Rakan W Grand Entrance when Swain E Nevermove is down and an ally you can return to with Rakan E Battle Dance is nearby.
Swain.laning: Do not force the wave forward; pressure Swain early while avoiding the outward and returning path of Swain E Nevermove.
Swain.phase: Rakan peaks in the mid game, when his mobility lets him shape fights, but Swain gets stronger as the game goes on. In the late game, Rakan is easy to catch right after engaging, so confirm Swain E Nevermove is down before going in.
Swain.teamfight: If Swain R Demonic Ascension is active, move outside its area and wait for it to end before re-engaging. If you are initiating, after Swain E Nevermove is down, charm him with Rakan R The Quickness and knock him up with Rakan W Grand Entrance. If you are protecting allies, hold Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up an enemy who engages, and use Rakan E Battle Dance's shield and Rakan Q Gleaming Quill's heal.
Swain.watch: Being hit by the wave of Swain E Nevermove that travels outward and returns also roots and pulls you, so stay out of its path until it fully disappears. Swain Q Death's Hand hits with overlapping bolts at close range, so keep your distance, and move outside the area when Swain R Demonic Ascension is active.

Taric.build: Build magic resistance before armor against the damage from Taric P Bravado and Taric E Dazzle. The provided information is insufficient to determine a specific item to buy first.
Taric.escape: The moment Taric E Dazzle misses is your chance to engage. Taric has no ability to create distance himself, so catch him with Rakan W Grand Entrance, then get out while Rakan E Battle Dance's recast to return to an ally is still available.
Taric.fight: Dodge Taric E Dazzle to the side, then poke with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill. Use Rakan W Grand Entrance to initiate when an ally is nearby to return to with Rakan E Battle Dance, and trade briefly so Taric cannot reduce his ability cooldowns with basic attacks.
Taric.laning: Hit Taric with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle unobstructed by minions to chip away at his health and prepare Rakan P Fey Feathers' shield. Engage when Taric E Dazzle is down and an ally is within Rakan E Battle Dance range.
Taric.phase: In the late game, it is dangerous if Rakan is caught right after engaging, so check your engage path and your way back to an ally.
Taric.teamfight: If you are initiating, touch an enemy with Rakan R The Quickness to charm them, then follow with Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock them up. While Taric R Cosmic Radiance's damage immunity is active, lock enemies down with crowd control and let your allies deal damage after it ends. If you need to protect an allied damage dealer, use Rakan W Grand Entrance to stop an engage and add Rakan E Battle Dance's shield and Rakan Q Gleaming Quill's heal.
Taric.watch: When Taric R Cosmic Radiance's damage immunity is active, stop attacking and use Rakan W Grand Entrance or Rakan R The Quickness to lock enemies down and wait out its duration.

Thresh.combo: For a short trade, use Rakan E Battle Dance to dash to an ally and shorten the engage distance, use Rakan W Grand Entrance, then return with the recast of Rakan E Battle Dance.
Thresh.escape: Dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence gives you a chance to close the distance. Look for an opening when Thresh W Dark Passage is also down, but avoid positions where Thresh E Flay can pull you. When going in with Rakan W Grand Entrance, make sure an ally is nearby for you to return to with Rakan E Battle Dance.
Thresh.fight: Close the distance just after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence, and engage when Thresh W Dark Passage is also down.
Thresh.laning: Poke Thresh when he walks forward to collect souls, and only start a fight after dodging Thresh Q Death Sentence when an ally is within Rakan E Battle Dance range.
Thresh.phase: In the mid game, use Rakan's mobility to keep roaming and setting up vision. In the late game, Rakan is easy to catch right after engaging, so check the position of the ally you can return to before going in.
Thresh.teamfight: If you need to catch an enemy damage dealer, charm multiple enemies with Rakan R The Quickness and knock them up with Rakan W Grand Entrance. If you need to protect an allied damage dealer, hold Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up an enemy who engages, and endure with Rakan E Battle Dance's shield and Rakan Q Gleaming Quill's heal. If Thresh W Dark Passage is thrown, immediately use a finishing ability or back off.

Velkoz.build: Build movement speed first so you can dodge Vel'Koz's area abilities. Build magic resistance against Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission, Vel'Koz W Void Rift, and Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, and get health against the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction and Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray.
Velkoz.escape: Vel'Koz has no mobility, so the moment after you dodge Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is your chance to close the distance. Check that an ally is positioned as a target for Rakan E Battle Dance, then go in with Rakan W Grand Entrance. Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption can knock you back if it hits at very close range, so dodge it before engaging.
Velkoz.fight: After dodging Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption, engage with Rakan W Grand Entrance when an ally is nearby to dash to with Rakan E Battle Dance. Before engaging, poke with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle unobstructed by minions and charge Rakan P Fey Feathers' shield. For a short trade, use Rakan E Battle Dance to dash to an ally and move forward, knock him up with Rakan W Grand Entrance, then return with Rakan E Battle Dance while it is available again.
Velkoz.laning: Hit Vel'Koz with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill to poke and heal from an angle with no minion line in the way, and do not force the wave forward. Clear vision around the river and tri-brush to create a path to approach from the side, and go in with an ally when Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption is down.
Velkoz.phase: In the late game, Rakan is easy to catch right after engaging, so do not engage while separated from your allies.
Velkoz.teamfight: When Vel'Koz R Life Form Disintegration Ray starts, prioritize interrupting the channel. If you are initiating, charm him with Rakan R The Quickness and knock him up with Rakan W Grand Entrance; if you are protecting allies, hold Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up an enemy who engages. When protecting an ally, use Rakan E Battle Dance's shield and Rakan Q Gleaming Quill's heal.
Velkoz.watch: Vel'Koz Q Plasma Fission hits both sides after splitting, so do not dodge only to the side; dive toward Vel'Koz or retreat behind where the beam passed. If you also get hit by Vel'Koz W Void Rift and Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption in succession, the true damage from Vel'Koz P Organic Deconstruction will trigger, so back off and let it run out when stacks are applied. It is best to dodge Vel'Koz E Tectonic Disruption before engaging.

Xerath.build: First get a way to cleanse or remove the stun from Xerath E Shocking Orb. Then get movement speed to leave the area of his telegraphed attacks, and build magic resistance.
Xerath.combo: For a short trade, use Rakan E Battle Dance to dash to an ally and move forward, knock him up with Rakan W Grand Entrance, then return with Rakan E Battle Dance while it is available again.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the moment after Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down is your window to engage. Close the distance with Rakan W Grand Entrance, but first check that an ally is available to return to with Rakan E Battle Dance. If Xerath R Rite of the Arcane is being cast, you can also engage him while he is unable to move.
Xerath.fight: Dodge to the side while Xerath Q Arcanopulse is charging and close the distance. When Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down and an ally is nearby to return to with Rakan E Battle Dance, go in with Rakan W Grand Entrance and follow with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and basic attacks.
Xerath.laning: Hit Xerath with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle where the minion line is clear to heal and use Rakan P Fey Feathers' shield. Avoid heavy damage and wait for Xerath to run low on mana, then push the lane and call your jungler.
Xerath.phase: Use your mobility to roam and set up vision in the mid game, when Rakan can shape fights, and engage carefully in the late game so you are not caught right after initiating.
Xerath.teamfight: If you need to engage, charm enemies along your path with Rakan R The Quickness, then follow with Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock them up. If you need to protect an allied damage dealer, hold Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up an enemy who engages, and endure with Rakan E Battle Dance's shield and Rakan Q Gleaming Quill's heal. When you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane being cast, move to dodge its area attacks or engage Xerath while he is unable to move.
Xerath.watch: If you are stunned by Xerath E Shocking Orb, it is hard to dodge the attacks that follow, so do not force an engage while this ability is available. Xerath Q Arcanopulse passes through minions, so when you see him charging it, change direction and dodge to the side. Start dodging immediately when you see Xerath R Rite of the Arcane being cast.

Zilean.build: Prioritize tenacity because the stun from two Zilean Q Time Bombs and the slow from Zilean E Time Warp are dangerous. Then build magic resistance against Zilean’s magic damage.
Zilean.combo: Close the gap from a brush or out of vision, knock them up with Rakan W Grand Entrance, then follow with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill and an auto attack. When you need to get out, use Rakan E Battle Dance to dash to an ally and engage, then return to an ally while the recast is available.
Zilean.escape: Look for an engage after Zilean has cast Zilean Q Time Bomb twice and used Zilean E Time Warp. Zilean has no mobility, so close the gap with Rakan W Grand Entrance. If an ally is nearby, keep a route open to return with Rakan E Battle Dance.
Zilean.fight: Poke with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle where minions won’t block it, and have Rakan P Fey Feathers’ shield ready. Before engaging with Rakan W Grand Entrance, make sure an ally is nearby so you can return to them with Rakan E Battle Dance.
Zilean.phase: Use Rakan’s mobility to create opportunities in the mid game. In the late game, engage carefully so you aren’t caught right after starting a fight.
Zilean.teamfight: If you’re initiating, charm multiple enemies with Rakan R The Quickness, then follow with Rakan W Grand Entrance. If you need to protect your carries, save Rakan W Grand Entrance to knock up enemies who engage, and use the shield from Rakan E Battle Dance and the healing from Rakan Q Gleaming Quill. If Zilean R Chronoshift is on an enemy carry and makes them hard to finish, switch to Zilean himself, who has no mobility and is fragile.
Zilean.watch: If Zilean Q Time Bomb attaches to you, move away from your allies and get outside its blast radius. If Zilean E Time Warp slows you, it becomes harder to dodge the next bomb.

Zyra.build: Since being rooted can stop you from moving right after you engage, buy Quicksilver Sash after your first core item. Build magic resistance against Zyra’s damage rather than armor.
Zyra.combo: For a basic engage, close the gap from a brush or out of vision, then use Rakan W Grand Entrance → Rakan Q Gleaming Quill → auto attack. To engage off an ally, use Rakan E Battle Dance → Rakan W Grand Entrance → recast Rakan E Battle Dance to return.
Zyra.escape: Zyra has no ability to create distance herself, so engage while Zyra E Grasping Roots is down. If Zyra R Stranglethorns is cast, use the Rakan W Grand Entrance or Rakan E Battle Dance you saved to leave the area.
Zyra.fight: Hit Zyra with Rakan Q Gleaming Quill from an angle where minions won’t block it to chip away at her health, and have Rakan P Fey Feathers’ shield ready. When Zyra E Grasping Roots misses and there are no plants nearby, engage with Rakan W Grand Entrance if an allied target is available for Rakan E Battle Dance to return to.
Zyra.laning: When Zyra tries to grow seeds with her abilities, back away instead of stepping on them. Don’t force the wave; look for an opening when the enemy marksman steps in front of the minions.
Zyra.phase: Take advantage of the mid game, when your mobility lets you disrupt fights. In the late game, be careful not to get caught by crowd control right after you engage.
Zyra.teamfight: Don’t fight in an area where Zyra has accumulated seeds and plants. Move to another objective and fight from a new position. If you need to protect your carries, save Rakan W Grand Entrance, and use the shield from Rakan E Battle Dance and the healing from Rakan Q Gleaming Quill.
Zyra.watch: Dodge the straight-line root from Zyra E Grasping Roots by moving sideways at the edge of its range. When you see the cast indicator for Zyra R Stranglethorns, leave the area and use Rakan W Grand Entrance or Rakan E Battle Dance if needed. Don’t fight where Zyra’s plants are clustered.
